# uzc_blockstorage_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud block storage snapshots (global list, not scoped to one volume).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_blockstorage_snapshots" "all" {}

output "blockstorage_snapshot_slugs" {
  value = [for s in data.uzc_blockstorage_snapshots.all.snapshots : s.slug]
}
```
